questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Rita was a model so she would starve herself to maintain their body weight.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is '**their body weight'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In this part of the sentence, the usage of **'their'** is incorrect Instead, use** 'her'**

As the subject of the sentence is singular hence we need to use the singular pronoun for this i.e. 'Her'. The subject of the sentence is 'Rita' also the verb is 'was' a model is a subject complement.

**So the correct sentence is-** *Rita was a model so she would starve herself to maintain **her** body weight.*

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.

Due to a last minute snag, the mission on a moon had to be cancelled.

options.text: Due to a last minute snag

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

There is an error in the use of the article. 'A' is an indefinite article and 'the' is a definite article. 

Moon is a definite noun, and therefore a definite article must be used.

The correct phrase is **'on the moon'.**

All other options are grammatically correct.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement

The two thieves divided the loot __among themselves.__
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

'Among' is used when something is divided between more than two people. 'Between' is used when something is divided between two people. 

Here, there are two thieves. So, we will use 'between'.

The correct phrase is **'between themselves'.**
